name: answer-reuse
title: Reuse a support answer before investigating

origin.source: Original pattern: judge the cached answer before spending an agent call

comparison.purpose: Judges the help article a search already found with Jev before spending an agent call: reuses it on a confident yes, otherwise investigates exactly once with read-only tools, rechecks, and settles idle for a person when the answer still does not pass.

starters: How do I reset my password?
How do I export my data as CSV?
Why was my card charged twice on March 3?
Can I move my workspace to the EU region?
